name: After § 19
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 19b. Recalls that the former Vice- President of the European Commission resigned from her rectorship at the College of Europe as a consequence of recent reports concerning an investigation into suspected fraud related to EU-funded training activities for diplomats, including allegations that may involve procurement fraud, corruption, conflicts of interest and breaches of professional secrecy, constituting a serious loss of credibility regarding the application of the rule of law by the EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies;
